name: Luke and Madhan
verifiedBody:
Hi Luke and Madhan,

Your Clebsch-based Ramsey construction looks interesting, and I would like to review the exact result behind it. Could you put the complete weighted two-colour graph, integer cluster weights, diagonal colours, exact K4 count/density, and the blow-up argument in the repository? Please identify the specific run and explain the improvement over the competition baseline and current literature. The earlier demo link was inaccessible, so downloadable source and a complete certificate are especially useful. Please also confirm the author roster and whether this is independent of, or collaborative with, the other leading Ramsey submissions.

Please send your current GitHub repository now and aim to have it mostly polished by the end of Friday, while respecting the official competition cutoff. Include all Lean files, other code and certificates; the paper in PDF and editable source; and a motivation/novelty document explaining the exact contribution, why it matters, its relation to prior work, and what was completed during the event. Add pinned dependencies, reproducible commands, data/logs, the full evaluator report and submission identifiers, author credits, and AI/model/compute disclosures. Clearly label unfinished proofs and limitations. A private repository is fine if we can access it and you permit review by both judges.

Stephen Wolfram is the other judge, and we want to put the most interesting, well-supported submissions in front of him. We would also like to explore developing strong results into papers together where the work and our contributions justify that. Please make the packet easy to inspect independently.

Thanks,
Alejandro
